QuestInfo.name: The Headmaster's First Lesson
QuestInfo.0: If you need help settling in the new world, go see #p2152000#, the Headmaster of the school in #m310000000#...
QuestInfo.1: #p2152000#, the Headmaster of the school in #m310000000#, says that he wants to help you settle in the new world with supplies and resources. However, he adds that nothing in this world is free, then asks you to bring him #b80 #t4000597#s#k, which can be obtained from #b#o150002#s#k. He offers a nice reward if you do so.\r\n\r\n#i4000597# #t4000597# #b#c4000597##k / 80
QuestInfo.2: #p2152000#, the Headmaster of the school in #m310000000#, rewarded you for the #t4000597# items you brought back. Your surroundings still feel unfamiliar, but you feel energized and ready to take on any challenge that awaits.

0.0: Hello. You must be a student entering the new world for the first time. I understand that it's very difficult to enter a new place, where nobody knows you. I can offer you some assistance. What do you think?

yes.0: Okay then. But, nothing in life is free. So, I will give you the help you need to settle into the new world, if you can bring me #b80 #t4000597#s#k from #b#o150002##k.

no.0: It is very admirable for you to go it alone, but please feel free to come back if you change your mind.

1.0: You've finally returned! Here, I will provide you with a little Settlement Fund that will help you get settled in the new world.

yes.0: A new adventure always starts in a new place. I will be watching your progress.
